verdict.rationale: Zero's repository ships an official MCP.md describing ZeroMCP. It exposes a broad tool set (get threads, list folders, send and draft emails, labels, bulk archive and delete, search, AI Q&A), so an agent can connect to Zero's own MCP server. Connecting is crude, though: the only available method is copying a browser session cookie into the Authorization header, OAuth is still 'coming soon', and an independent check found only a prose capability list with no endpoint schema or docs site. Missing for 10: production-grade auth (OAuth), a documented endpoint/URL and tool schemas, setup docs for MCP clients, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a working connection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: You can connecto ZeroMCP using two methods: 1. Better Auth session token 2. OAuth (Coming soon)
Copy the session cookie from your browser cookies and place it into the Authorization header.
Get email threads by ID - List emails in specific folders - Create and send new emails - Create email drafts - Send existing drafts - Delete emails

a prose capability list ("Zero MCP provides the following capabilities": get threads, list folders, create and send emails) authenticated by copying a browser session cookie, with no endpoint schema and OAuth marked coming soon
